{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_016iNgxHWgzFBwFMxUWCf8ro","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing Guardrails.Core.Graph;\n2\t\n3\tnamespace Guardrails.Core.Tests;\n4\t\n5\t/// <summary>\n6\t/// Unit tests for <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> (issue #33): the self-contained local\n7\t/// <c>diagram.html</c> viewer. Pure string mapping — no disk. Pins the provenance line, the\n8\t/// verbatim-source embedding, the interaction prerequisites (loose security for clicks, pan/zoom,\n9\t/// fullscreen), determinism, and newline normalization.\n10\t/// </summary>\n11\tpublic sealed class HtmlDiagramRendererTests\n12\t{\n13\t    private const string Hash = \"abc123def456\";\n14\t    private const string Source = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_a[\\\"a\\\"]:::task\\n  classDef task fill:#cfe8ff;\";\n15\t\n16\t    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> NoTargets =\n17\t        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n18\t\n19\t    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> OneTarget =\n20\t        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_a\"] = \"tasks/01-a/\" };\n21\t\n22\t    [Fact]\n23\t    public void Render_FirstLine_IsProvenanceComment_WithSameHash()\n24\t    {\n25\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n26\t        string firstLine = html.Split('\\n')[0];\n27\t\n28\t        // Same provenance shape as diagram.md, and FIRST so the \\A-anchored reader (graph --check)\n29\t        // matches it in both files.\n30\t        Assert.Equal($\"<!-- guardrails:graph v1 source-sha256={Hash} -->\", firstLine);\n31\t    }\n32\t\n33\t    [Fact]\n34\t    public void Render_EmbedsSourceVerbatim_InRawTextScript()\n35\t    {\n36\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n37\t\n38\t        Assert.Contains(\"type=\\\"text/plain\\\"\", html);\n39\t        Assert.Contains(Source, html); // verbatim — not interpolated into a JS string\n40\t        Assert.Contains(\"<!doctype html>\", html);\n41\t    }\n42\t\n43\t    [Fact]\n44\t    public void Render_EnablesClicksAndNavigation()\n45\t    {\n46\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n47\t\n48\t        // Clicks (node -> source file) only fire when mermaid runs in 'loose' security.\n49\t        Assert.Contains(\"securityLevel: 'loose'\", html);\n50\t        // Pan/zoom + fullscreen affordances.\n51\t        Assert.Contains(\"svg-pan-zoom\", html);\n52\t        Assert.Contains(\"requestFullscreen\", html);\n53\t    }\n54\t\n55\t    [Fact]\n56\t    public void Render_RaisesMermaidSizeCeilings_SoLargeDagsRender()\n57\t    {\n58\t        // Issue #108: a large plan's DAG source exceeds Mermaid's default 50 000-char maxTextSize\n59\t        // and/or 500-edge maxEdges ceiling, so mermaid.render throws and the page falls back to\n60\t        // \"could not render\". The fix lifts BOTH ceilings in mermaid.initialize — assert they are\n61\t        // present (a regression that drops either re-introduces the big-plan render failure).\n62\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n63\t\n64\t        Assert.Contains(\"maxTextSize: 5000000\", html);\n65\t        Assert.Contains(\"maxEdges: 100000\", html);\n66\t    }\n67\t\n68\t    [Fact]\n69\t    public void Render_IsDeterministic()\n70\t    {\n71\t        Assert.Equal(\n72\t            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget),\n73\t            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget));\n74\t    }\n75\t\n76\t    [Fact]\n77\t    public void Render_NormalizesCrlf_NoCarriageReturnsInOutput()\n78\t    {\n79\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\"flowchart TD\\r\\n  a-->b\\r\\n\", Hash, NoTargets);\n80\t        Assert.DoesNotContain('\\r', html);\n81\t    }\n82\t\n83\t    [Fact]\n84\t    public void Render_EmptyHash_Throws()\n85\t    {\n86\t        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, \"\", NoTargets));\n87\t    }\n88\t\n89\t    [Fact]\n90\t    public void Render_NullTaskFolderTargets_Throws()\n91\t    {\n92\t        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, null!));\n93\t    }\n94\t\n95\t    // === legend overlay (outside the Mermaid graph; see MermaidRenderer remarks) =======\n96\t\n97\t    [Fact]\n98\t    public void Render_IncludesALegendOverlayDiv_OutsideTheEmbeddedMermaidSource()\n99\t    {\n100\t        // A Mermaid-native legend was prototyped and rendered broken headless (dagre treats a\n101\t        // disconnected subgraph as a phantom extra \"task\"); the only working placement is an HTML\n102\t        // overlay div outside the embedded Mermaid <script> source, mirroring #bar/#hint.\n103\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n104\t\n105\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"legend\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n106\t    }\n107\t\n108\t    [Fact]\n109\t    public void Render_LegendOverlay_StatesBothAColorAndABeforeAfterTimingWord()\n110\t    {\n111\t        // A bare category name would not preserve the \"preflights run before, guardrails run\n112\t        // after\" semantic the removed nested boxes used to convey visually — the legend must spell\n113\t        // out both the colour mapping AND the timing/consequence in words.\n114\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n115\t\n116\t        Assert.Contains(\"Preflight\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n117\t        Assert.Contains(\"Guardrail\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n118\t        Assert.Contains(\"BEFORE\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n119\t        Assert.Contains(\"AFTER\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n120\t    }\n121\t\n122\t    [Fact]\n123\t    public void Render_LegendOverlay_IsNotInsideTheEmbeddedGraphSourceScript()\n124\t    {\n125\t        // The legend must live OUTSIDE the raw-text <script id=\"graph-source\"> element — it is\n126\t        // not part of the Mermaid source, so it can never affect anything that parses that source\n127\t        // (rendering) or hashes it (GraphSourceHash, via MermaidRenderer.SemanticContent).\n128\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n129\t\n130\t        int scriptStart = html.IndexOf(\"id=\\\"graph-source\\\"\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n131\t        int scriptEnd = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", scriptStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n132\t        string scriptContent = html[scriptStart..scriptEnd];\n133\t\n134\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"legend\", scriptContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n135\t    }\n136\t\n137\t    // === task-container title-band overlay (issue #232/#233 superseded, issue #235) ====\n138\t    //\n139\t    // The Mermaid-source anchor-node mechanism (#211) proved useless in practice — a real\n140\t    // headless-Chrome measurement found the anchor covering only 0.44% of a content-dense\n141\t    // container's area, off-center, missed by every realistic click point. The fix instead\n142\t    // injects a post-render SVG overlay on the container's title/label band via JavaScript.\n143\t\n144\t    [Fact]\n145\t    public void Render_EmbedsTaskFolderTargets_AsJsonSideTable()\n146\t    {\n147\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n148\t\n149\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n150\t        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_a\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n151\t        Assert.Contains(\"tasks/01-a/\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n152\t    }\n153\t\n154\t    [Fact]\n155\t    public void Render_NoLongerEmitsAnchorNodeMechanism()\n156\t    {\n157\t        // The #211 anchor-node click mechanism (Mermaid-source invisible node + classDef) is\n158\t        // superseded entirely — HtmlDiagramRenderer must not reference it either.\n159\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n160\t\n161\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"classDef invisible\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n162\t    }\n163\t\n164\t    [Fact]\n165\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_AppendsToCluster_NotInsertsFirst()\n166\t    {\n167\t        // Load-bearing z-order fix: appendChild (not insertBefore as firstChild) — see class\n168\t        // remarks and HtmlDiagramRenderer's remarks for why insertBefore silently blocks clicks\n169\t        // (it lands the overlay BEHIND the cluster's own background rect).\n170\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n171\t\n172\t        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.appendChild(a)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n173\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"insertBefore(a, cluster.firstChild\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n174\t    }\n175\t\n176\t    [Fact]\n177\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_ComputesBandFromClusterAndLabelBBox()\n178\t    {\n179\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n180\t\n181\t        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n182\t        Assert.Contains(\"label.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n183\t        Assert.Contains(\".cluster-label\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n184\t    }\n185\t\n186\t    [Fact]\n187\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_UsesTransparentFill_NotNone()\n188\t    {\n189\t        // Same hit-testing hazard as the retired anchor node: fill:none is invisible to\n190\t        // pointer-events:visiblePainted hit-testing; the overlay rect must use a painted-but-\n191\t        // invisible transparent fill instead.\n192\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n193\t\n194\t        Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n195\t    }\n196\t\n197\t    [Fact]\n198\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_SetsFillViaInlineStyle_NotTheFillAttribute()\n199\t    {\n200\t        // Real-browser regression (found live, not guessed): Mermaid's own generated stylesheet\n201\t        // carries a rule shaped like `#dag .cluster rect{fill:<theme color>;...}`. Since the\n202\t        // overlay rect is nested inside the .cluster group, that selector matches it too — and a\n203\t        // CSS class/tag selector beats a plain HTML presentation attribute, so\n204\t        // `rect.setAttribute('fill', 'transparent')` was silently overridden, painting a solid\n205\t        // theme-colored bar over the container's title text (confirmed via getComputedStyle:\n206\t        // attribute said \"transparent\", computed fill was the theme's cluster-background color).\n207\t        // An inline style (`rect.style.fill = ...`) wins over any external/embedded stylesheet\n208\t        // rule short of `!important`, so it reliably stays invisible. This test would have caught\n209\t        // the regression: `Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\")` alone passes for EITHER form.\n210\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n211\t\n212\t        Assert.Contains(\"rect.style.fill = 'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n213\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"rect.setAttribute('fill'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n214\t    }\n215\t\n216\t    [Fact]\n217\t    public void Render_OverlayScript_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves()\n218\t    {\n219\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n220\t\n221\t        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n222\t        int overlayDefinition = html.IndexOf(\"function addTaskContainerOverlays\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n223\t        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && overlayDefinition >= 0, \"both the render call and overlay function must be present\");\n224\t\n225\t        // The overlay must be INVOKED after the render call (the definition itself may appear\n226\t        // earlier in the script — only invocation order matters for correctness).\n227\t        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n228\t        Assert.True(overlayInvocation > renderCall, \"the overlay must be applied to the SVG mermaid.render just produced\");\n229\t    }\n230\t\n231\t    [Fact]\n232\t    public void Render_EmptyTaskFolderTargets_StillRendersValidPage()\n233\t    {\n234\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n235\t\n236\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n237\t        Assert.Contains(\"{}\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n238\t    }\n239\t\n240\t    // === long task-name title wrap-overflow fix (issue cluster-label-wrap-overflow) ====\n241\t    //\n242\t    // Mermaid always wraps a cluster's title <div> to a hardcoded 200px width (bundled\n243\t    // mermaid@11.4.1's plain flowchart cluster shape never overrides createText's width=200\n244\t    // default), and dagre's layout pass reserves the container's header-strip height BEFORE that\n245\t    // wrapped height is known — so a long kebab-case task name that wraps to 2+ lines prints past\n246\t    // the reserved strip, overlapping the first leaf guardrail/preflight box below it. No Mermaid\n247\t    // config knob avoids this (verified against the bundled 11.4.1 source). The fix re-wraps the\n248\t    // SAME text at up to the container's own (already wider) width post-render instead, verified\n249\t    // headless against 8+ real plans (40+ long task names, container widths ~230px-~1100px,\n250\t    // wraps of 2-3 lines): every case converged to one line with the same healthy gap a\n251\t    // never-wrapped label already has, and every already-fits label was left byte-for-byte\n252\t    // unchanged (including the whole golden hello-guardrails example).\n253\t\n254\t    [Fact]\n255\t    public void Render_DefinesFixWrappedClusterLabelsFunction()\n256\t    {\n257\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n258\t\n259\t        Assert.Contains(\"function fixWrappedClusterLabels(svgEl)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n260\t    }\n261\t\n262\t    [Fact]\n263\t    public void Render_WrapFix_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves_AndBeforeTheOverlay()\n264\t    {\n265\t        // Ordering is load-bearing: addTaskContainerOverlays measures the label's CURRENT bbox to\n266\t        // size its click band, so a label the wrap fix already shrank back to one line must be\n267\t        // fixed FIRST, or the band would be sized for the original (possibly multi-line) wrap.\n268\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n269\t\n270\t        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n271\t        int wrapFixInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"fixWrappedClusterLabels(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n272\t        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n273\t\n274\t        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && wrapFixInvocation > renderCall && overlayInvocation > renderCall,\n275\t            \"both post-render fixes must be invoked after the render call\");\n276\t        Assert.True(wrapFixInvocation < overlayInvocation,\n277\t            \"the wrap fix must run BEFORE the title-band overlay so the band reflects the corrected label size\");\n278\t    }\n279\t\n280\t    [Fact]\n281\t    public void Render_WrapFix_MeasuresViaScrollWidth_NotGetBoundingClientRect()\n282\t    {\n283\t        // Regression guard for the exact measurement pitfall this fix's own investigation hit:\n284\t        // getBoundingClientRect() reports on-screen pixels affected by the page's pan-zoom\n285\t        // transform, which is misleading when compared against a foreignObject's local width/\n286\t        // height attributes. scrollWidth/scrollHeight are local layout-box measurements, in the\n287\t        // SAME coordinate system as those attributes, regardless of the current zoom level.\n288\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n289\t\n290\t        int fnStart = html.IndexOf(\"function fixWrappedClusterLabels\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n291\t        int fnEnd = html.IndexOf(\"\\n}\\n\", fnStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n292\t        string fnBody = html[fnStart..fnEnd];\n293\t\n294\t        Assert.Contains(\"div.scrollWidth\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n295\t        Assert.Contains(\"div.scrollHeight\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n296\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"getBoundingClientRect\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n297\t    }\n298\t\n299\t    [Fact]\n300\t    public void Render_WrapFix_NeverNarrowsBelowMermaidsOriginalWidth()\n301\t    {\n302\t        // The fix only ever WIDENS a label (fewer lines needs less height, never more) — it must\n303\t        // never choose a width narrower than what Mermaid already assigned, which would be a\n304\t        // regression risking MORE wrapping, not less.\n305\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n306\t\n307\t        Assert.Contains(\"Math.max(currentWidth, clusterBox.width - 16)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n308\t    }\n309\t\n310\t    [Fact]\n311\t    public void Render_WrapFix_SkipsLabelsThatAlreadyFitOnOneLine()\n312\t    {\n313\t        // Short names (e.g. every task in the golden hello-guardrails example) must be left\n314\t        // completely untouched — this is the guard that makes that a no-op.\n315\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n316\t\n317\t        Assert.Contains(\"if (naturalWidth <= currentWidth) continue;\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n318\t    }\n319\t\n320\t    [Fact]\n321\t    public void Render_WrapFix_RevertsWhenWideningDoesNotReduceHeight()\n322\t    {\n323\t        // A container too narrow to help must fall back to Mermaid's original sizing rather than\n324\t        // risk an oddly-proportioned label — never regress relative to the pre-fix rendering.\n325\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n326\t\n327\t        Assert.Contains(\"if (newHeight >= currentHeight)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n328\t        Assert.Contains(\"div.setAttribute('style', savedInline);\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n329\t    }\n330\t\n331\t    [Fact]\n332\t    public void Render_WrapFix_RecentersTheLabelOnTheSameMidpointAfterWidening()\n333\t    {\n334\t        // Mermaid centers the label group via translate(x - bbox.width / 2, y); widening without\n335\t        // re-centering would shift the (now wider) box off-center over the cluster.\n336\t        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n337\t\n338\t        Assert.Contains(\"deltaCenter\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n339\t        Assert.Contains(\"label.setAttribute('transform',\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n340\t    }\n341\t\n342\t    // === live per-node status overlay (issue #219) =====================================\n343\t    //\n344\t    // While a `guardrails run` is in progress, diagram.html gains a small corner-anchored status\n345\t    // badge on each task container, preflight/guardrail leaf, and the plan-level Full Flight Checks\n346\t    // / Terminal Gate brackets: an animated spinner while running, a settled check/X/\"?\" glyph once\n347\t    // finished — driven by an OPTIONAL per-node status map plus an INDEPENDENT includeRefresh\n348\t    // toggle, mirroring LogSiteRenderer.IndexHtml(..., includeRefresh)'s during-run/final duality.\n349\t    //\n350\t    // These tests are structural/string-content assertions over the emitted HTML/JS (no headless\n351\t    // browser is configured in this repo — a documented Level-A gap): they prove the right markup\n352\t    // and data are EMITTED, not that a browser positions the badges pixel-correctly at runtime. The\n353\t    // four non-null-status tests are the intended TDD RED against the throwing stub — the\n354\t    // 02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer task turns them green.\n355\t    //\n356\t    // Status-map ids use the SAME vocabulary MermaidRenderer emits (task containers `task_<base>`,\n357\t    // preflight/guardrail leaves `task_<base>_pf_<n>`/`task_<base>_gr_<n>`, and the two plan-level\n358\t    // brackets `plan_preflights`/`plan_guardrails`) so the post-render overlay script can position a\n359\t    // badge on the matching SVG node. All five status values are exercised.\n360\t    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> SampleStatuses =\n361\t        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)\n362\t        {\n363\t            [\"plan_preflights\"] = \"passed\",       // Full Flight Checks bracket (top)\n364\t            [\"task_root\"] = \"running\",            // a task container, mid-run -> spinner\n365\t            [\"task_root_pf_0\"] = \"passed\",        // a preflight leaf check\n366\t            [\"task_root_gr_0\"] = \"failed\",        // a guardrail leaf check\n367\t            [\"task_next\"] = \"pending\",            // a not-yet-started task container\n368\t            [\"plan_guardrails\"] = \"needs-human\",  // Terminal Gate bracket (bottom)\n369\t        };\n370\t\n371\t    [Fact]\n372\t    public void Render_WithNullNodeStatuses_IsByteIdenticalToCurrentBehavior()\n373\t    {\n374\t        // The static `graph` command path (no live status) must be UNCHANGED by this feature: the\n375\t        // pre-existing three-argument overload and the new call passing nodeStatuses:null must\n376\t        // produce the exact same document, byte-for-byte — the golden fixtures\n377\t        // (examples/hello-guardrails, docs/plans/08-parallel-execution/diagram.html) are out of this\n378\t        // task's scope and must not need regenerating.\n379\t        string legacy = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n380\t        string newNull = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n381\t\n382\t        Assert.Equal(legacy, newNull);\n383\t\n384\t        // ...and the static path carries NONE of the live-overlay markers. Each of these is absent\n385\t        // from today's template, so their absence pins the null path clean — a leak of the feature\n386\t        // into the static path (which would silently change every checked-in diagram.html) fails here.\n387\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n388\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"@keyframes\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n389\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n390\t    }\n391\t\n392\t    [Fact]\n393\t    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAMetaRefreshTag()\n394\t    {\n395\t        // A non-null status map with the default includeRefresh:true is the DURING-RUN diagram — it\n396\t        // must carry <meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"> so a plain file:// view re-reads itself as the run\n397\t        // progresses (mirrors LogSiteRenderer's during-run index). The static (null) path must not.\n398\t        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n399\t        Assert.Contains(\"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n400\t\n401\t        string stat = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n402\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", stat, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n403\t    }\n404\t\n405\t    [Fact]\n406\t    public void Render_WithNodeStatusesAndIncludeRefreshFalse_OmitsTheMetaRefreshTag()\n407\t    {\n408\t        // The FINAL settled render (wired at run-end by 06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand):\n409\t        // nodeStatuses is STILL non-null (every node shows its final settled status) but\n410\t        // includeRefresh:false, so the auto-reload tag is dropped — the page is done refreshing. The\n411\t        // status overlay itself must STILL be emitted (the refresh tag and the overlay are independent).\n412\t        string settled = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\n413\t            Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses, includeRefresh: false);\n414\t\n415\t        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n416\t        // still a live-status document — the overlay data is present regardless of includeRefresh.\n417\t        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n418\t        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_root\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n419\t    }\n420\t\n421\t    [Fact]\n422\t    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAnOverlayForEachStatusEntry()\n423\t    {\n424\t        // Every node id in the status map must be referenced by the overlay-rendering logic — the\n425\t        // map is embedded as a JSON side-table (mirroring the task-folder-targets side-table) keyed\n426\t        // by the SAME Mermaid node/container ids, so the post-render script can position a badge on\n427\t        // each matching SVG node. Assert the QUOTED (JSON-key) form: a bare-word check would false-\n428\t        // positive on ids like `plan_guardrails` that ALREADY appear in a code comment in today's\n429\t        // template — only the emitted status map produces the quoted form.\n430\t        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n431\t\n432\t        foreach (string nodeId in SampleStatuses.Keys)\n433\t        {\n434\t            Assert.Contains($\"\\\"{nodeId}\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n435\t        }\n436\t    }\n437\t\n438\t    [Fact]\n439\t    public void Render_WithRunningStatus_EmitsASpinnerClass_AndSettledStatusesEmitAGlyph()\n440\t    {\n441\t        // \"running\" must render an ANIMATED spinner (a CSS @keyframes rotation — no external\n442\t        // image/GIF dependency), visibly distinct from a settled status's STATIC glyph (check / X /\n443\t        // \"?\"). Written as literal UTF-8 glyphs; this file is valid UTF-8, which Roslyn's\n454\t        // BOM-less source detection decodes as UTF-8, so the literals compile to exactly these chars.\n455\t        Assert.Contains(\"✓\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n456\t        Assert.Contains(\"✗\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n457\t    }\n458\t\n459\t    // === diagram search box (issue #220) ================================================\n460\t    //\n461\t    // A fixed-position #search-box overlay (same technique as #legend/#bar/#hint and the status\n462\t    // badges) sits alongside the live status overlay: a search <input>, a \"N of M\" match counter\n463\t    // with next/prev controls, and client-side JS that substring-matches the typed text against\n464\t    // every Mermaid node's id + visible label, toggles a highlight/dim class per node, and auto\n465\t    // pans/zooms to the first match via the already-loaded svg-pan-zoom instance. UNLIKE the status\n466\t    // overlay, this is unconditional — present regardless of nodeStatuses.\n467\t    //\n468\t    // These are structural/string-content assertions (no headless browser is configured in this\n469\t    // repo — a documented Level-A gap): they prove the right markup/data/script is EMITTED, not\n470\t    // that a browser actually matches, highlights, and pans/zooms at runtime. The search-index side\n471\t    // -table is a deliberate stub (BuildSearchIndexJson always returns \"{}\"), so\n472\t    // Render_SearchScript_ReferencesEveryNodeIdAndLabel is the intended TDD RED Guardrails.Core.Graph;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Core.Tests;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// Unit tests for <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> (issue #33): the self-contained local\n/// <c>diagram.html</c> viewer. Pure string mapping — no disk. Pins the provenance line, the\n/// verbatim-source embedding, the interaction prerequisites (loose security for clicks, pan/zoom,\n/// fullscreen), determinism, and newline normalization.\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class HtmlDiagramRendererTests\n{\n    private const string Hash = \"abc123def456\";\n    private const string Source = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_a[\\\"a\\\"]:::task\\n  classDef task fill:#cfe8ff;\";\n\n    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> NoTargets =\n        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n\n    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> OneTarget =\n        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_a\"] = \"tasks/01-a/\" };\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_FirstLine_IsProvenanceComment_WithSameHash()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n        string firstLine = html.Split('\\n')[0];\n\n        // Same provenance shape as diagram.md, and FIRST so the \\A-anchored reader (graph --check)\n        // matches it in both files.\n        Assert.Equal($\"<!-- guardrails:graph v1 source-sha256={Hash} -->\", firstLine);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmbedsSourceVerbatim_InRawTextScript()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"type=\\\"text/plain\\\"\", html);\n        Assert.Contains(Source, html); // verbatim — not interpolated into a JS string\n        Assert.Contains(\"<!doctype html>\", html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EnablesClicksAndNavigation()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        // Clicks (node -> source file) only fire when mermaid runs in 'loose' security.\n        Assert.Contains(\"securityLevel: 'loose'\", html);\n        // Pan/zoom + fullscreen affordances.\n        Assert.Contains(\"svg-pan-zoom\", html);\n        Assert.Contains(\"requestFullscreen\", html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_RaisesMermaidSizeCeilings_SoLargeDagsRender()\n    {\n        // Issue #108: a large plan's DAG source exceeds Mermaid's default 50 000-char maxTextSize\n        // and/or 500-edge maxEdges ceiling, so mermaid.render throws and the page falls back to\n        // \"could not render\". The fix lifts BOTH ceilings in mermaid.initialize — assert they are\n        // present (a regression that drops either re-introduces the big-plan render failure).\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"maxTextSize: 5000000\", html);\n        Assert.Contains(\"maxEdges: 100000\", html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_IsDeterministic()\n    {\n        Assert.Equal(\n            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget),\n            HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_NormalizesCrlf_NoCarriageReturnsInOutput()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\"flowchart TD\\r\\n  a-->b\\r\\n\", Hash, NoTargets);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain('\\r', html);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmptyHash_Throws()\n    {\n        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, \"\", NoTargets));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_NullTaskFolderTargets_Throws()\n    {\n        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, null!));\n    }\n\n    // === legend overlay (outside the Mermaid graph; see MermaidRenderer remarks) =======\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_IncludesALegendOverlayDiv_OutsideTheEmbeddedMermaidSource()\n    {\n        // A Mermaid-native legend was prototyped and rendered broken headless (dagre treats a\n        // disconnected subgraph as a phantom extra \"task\"); the only working placement is an HTML\n        // overlay div outside the embedded Mermaid <script> source, mirroring #bar/#hint.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"legend\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_LegendOverlay_StatesBothAColorAndABeforeAfterTimingWord()\n    {\n        // A bare category name would not preserve the \"preflights run before, guardrails run\n        // after\" semantic the removed nested boxes used to convey visually — the legend must spell\n        // out both the colour mapping AND the timing/consequence in words.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"Preflight\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"Guardrail\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"BEFORE\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"AFTER\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_LegendOverlay_IsNotInsideTheEmbeddedGraphSourceScript()\n    {\n        // The legend must live OUTSIDE the raw-text <script id=\"graph-source\"> element — it is\n        // not part of the Mermaid source, so it can never affect anything that parses that source\n        // (rendering) or hashes it (GraphSourceHash, via MermaidRenderer.SemanticContent).\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        int scriptStart = html.IndexOf(\"id=\\\"graph-source\\\"\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int scriptEnd = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", scriptStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        string scriptContent = html[scriptStart..scriptEnd];\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"legend\", scriptContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    // === task-container title-band overlay (issue #232/#233 superseded, issue #235) ====\n    //\n    // The Mermaid-source anchor-node mechanism (#211) proved useless in practice — a real\n    // headless-Chrome measurement found the anchor covering only 0.44% of a content-dense\n    // container's area, off-center, missed by every realistic click point. The fix instead\n    // injects a post-render SVG overlay on the container's title/label band via JavaScript.\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmbedsTaskFolderTargets_AsJsonSideTable()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_01_a\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"tasks/01-a/\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_NoLongerEmitsAnchorNodeMechanism()\n    {\n        // The #211 anchor-node click mechanism (Mermaid-source invisible node + classDef) is\n        // superseded entirely — HtmlDiagramRenderer must not reference it either.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"classDef invisible\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_AppendsToCluster_NotInsertsFirst()\n    {\n        // Load-bearing z-order fix: appendChild (not insertBefore as firstChild) — see class\n        // remarks and HtmlDiagramRenderer's remarks for why insertBefore silently blocks clicks\n        // (it lands the overlay BEHIND the cluster's own background rect).\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.appendChild(a)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"insertBefore(a, cluster.firstChild\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_ComputesBandFromClusterAndLabelBBox()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"cluster.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"label.getBBox()\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\".cluster-label\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_UsesTransparentFill_NotNone()\n    {\n        // Same hit-testing hazard as the retired anchor node: fill:none is invisible to\n        // pointer-events:visiblePainted hit-testing; the overlay rect must use a painted-but-\n        // invisible transparent fill instead.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_SetsFillViaInlineStyle_NotTheFillAttribute()\n    {\n        // Real-browser regression (found live, not guessed): Mermaid's own generated stylesheet\n        // carries a rule shaped like `#dag .cluster rect{fill:<theme color>;...}`. Since the\n        // overlay rect is nested inside the .cluster group, that selector matches it too — and a\n        // CSS class/tag selector beats a plain HTML presentation attribute, so\n        // `rect.setAttribute('fill', 'transparent')` was silently overridden, painting a solid\n        // theme-colored bar over the container's title text (confirmed via getComputedStyle:\n        // attribute said \"transparent\", computed fill was the theme's cluster-background color).\n        // An inline style (`rect.style.fill = ...`) wins over any external/embedded stylesheet\n        // rule short of `!important`, so it reliably stays invisible. This test would have caught\n        // the regression: `Assert.Contains(\"'transparent'\")` alone passes for EITHER form.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"rect.style.fill = 'transparent'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"rect.setAttribute('fill'\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_OverlayScript_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int overlayDefinition = html.IndexOf(\"function addTaskContainerOverlays\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && overlayDefinition >= 0, \"both the render call and overlay function must be present\");\n\n        // The overlay must be INVOKED after the render call (the definition itself may appear\n        // earlier in the script — only invocation order matters for correctness).\n        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(overlayInvocation > renderCall, \"the overlay must be applied to the SVG mermaid.render just produced\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_EmptyTaskFolderTargets_StillRendersValidPage()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"task-folder-targets\\\"\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"{}\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    // === long task-name title wrap-overflow fix (issue cluster-label-wrap-overflow) ====\n    //\n    // Mermaid always wraps a cluster's title <div> to a hardcoded 200px width (bundled\n    // mermaid@11.4.1's plain flowchart cluster shape never overrides createText's width=200\n    // default), and dagre's layout pass reserves the container's header-strip height BEFORE that\n    // wrapped height is known — so a long kebab-case task name that wraps to 2+ lines prints past\n    // the reserved strip, overlapping the first leaf guardrail/preflight box below it. No Mermaid\n    // config knob avoids this (verified against the bundled 11.4.1 source). The fix re-wraps the\n    // SAME text at up to the container's own (already wider) width post-render instead, verified\n    // headless against 8+ real plans (40+ long task names, container widths ~230px-~1100px,\n    // wraps of 2-3 lines): every case converged to one line with the same healthy gap a\n    // never-wrapped label already has, and every already-fits label was left byte-for-byte\n    // unchanged (including the whole golden hello-guardrails example).\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_DefinesFixWrappedClusterLabelsFunction()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"function fixWrappedClusterLabels(svgEl)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_RunsAfterMermaidRenderResolves_AndBeforeTheOverlay()\n    {\n        // Ordering is load-bearing: addTaskContainerOverlays measures the label's CURRENT bbox to\n        // size its click band, so a label the wrap fix already shrank back to one line must be\n        // fixed FIRST, or the band would be sized for the original (possibly multi-line) wrap.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        int renderCall = html.IndexOf(\"await mermaid.render(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int wrapFixInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"fixWrappedClusterLabels(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int overlayInvocation = html.IndexOf(\"addTaskContainerOverlays(\", renderCall, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        Assert.True(renderCall >= 0 && wrapFixInvocation > renderCall && overlayInvocation > renderCall,\n            \"both post-render fixes must be invoked after the render call\");\n        Assert.True(wrapFixInvocation < overlayInvocation,\n            \"the wrap fix must run BEFORE the title-band overlay so the band reflects the corrected label size\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_MeasuresViaScrollWidth_NotGetBoundingClientRect()\n    {\n        // Regression guard for the exact measurement pitfall this fix's own investigation hit:\n        // getBoundingClientRect() reports on-screen pixels affected by the page's pan-zoom\n        // transform, which is misleading when compared against a foreignObject's local width/\n        // height attributes. scrollWidth/scrollHeight are local layout-box measurements, in the\n        // SAME coordinate system as those attributes, regardless of the current zoom level.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        int fnStart = html.IndexOf(\"function fixWrappedClusterLabels\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        int fnEnd = html.IndexOf(\"\\n}\\n\", fnStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        string fnBody = html[fnStart..fnEnd];\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"div.scrollWidth\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"div.scrollHeight\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"getBoundingClientRect\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_NeverNarrowsBelowMermaidsOriginalWidth()\n    {\n        // The fix only ever WIDENS a label (fewer lines needs less height, never more) — it must\n        // never choose a width narrower than what Mermaid already assigned, which would be a\n        // regression risking MORE wrapping, not less.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"Math.max(currentWidth, clusterBox.width - 16)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_SkipsLabelsThatAlreadyFitOnOneLine()\n    {\n        // Short names (e.g. every task in the golden hello-guardrails example) must be left\n        // completely untouched — this is the guard that makes that a no-op.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"if (naturalWidth <= currentWidth) continue;\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_RevertsWhenWideningDoesNotReduceHeight()\n    {\n        // A container too narrow to help must fall back to Mermaid's original sizing rather than\n        // risk an oddly-proportioned label — never regress relative to the pre-fix rendering.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"if (newHeight >= currentHeight)\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"div.setAttribute('style', savedInline);\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WrapFix_RecentersTheLabelOnTheSameMidpointAfterWidening()\n    {\n        // Mermaid centers the label group via translate(x - bbox.width / 2, y); widening without\n        // re-centering would shift the (now wider) box off-center over the cluster.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"deltaCenter\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"label.setAttribute('transform',\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    // === live per-node status overlay (issue #219) =====================================\n    //\n    // While a `guardrails run` is in progress, diagram.html gains a small corner-anchored status\n    // badge on each task container, preflight/guardrail leaf, and the plan-level Full Flight Checks\n    // / Terminal Gate brackets: an animated spinner while running, a settled check/X/\"?\" glyph once\n    // finished — driven by an OPTIONAL per-node status map plus an INDEPENDENT includeRefresh\n    // toggle, mirroring LogSiteRenderer.IndexHtml(..., includeRefresh)'s during-run/final duality.\n    //\n    // These tests are structural/string-content assertions over the emitted HTML/JS (no headless\n    // browser is configured in this repo — a documented Level-A gap): they prove the right markup\n    // and data are EMITTED, not that a browser positions the badges pixel-correctly at runtime. The\n    // four non-null-status tests are the intended TDD RED against the throwing stub — the\n    // 02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer task turns them green.\n    //\n    // Status-map ids use the SAME vocabulary MermaidRenderer emits (task containers `task_<base>`,\n    // preflight/guardrail leaves `task_<base>_pf_<n>`/`task_<base>_gr_<n>`, and the two plan-level\n    // brackets `plan_preflights`/`plan_guardrails`) so the post-render overlay script can position a\n    // badge on the matching SVG node. All five status values are exercised.\n    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> SampleStatuses =\n        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)\n        {\n            [\"plan_preflights\"] = \"passed\",       // Full Flight Checks bracket (top)\n            [\"task_root\"] = \"running\",            // a task container, mid-run -> spinner\n            [\"task_root_pf_0\"] = \"passed\",        // a preflight leaf check\n            [\"task_root_gr_0\"] = \"failed\",        // a guardrail leaf check\n            [\"task_next\"] = \"pending\",            // a not-yet-started task container\n            [\"plan_guardrails\"] = \"needs-human\",  // Terminal Gate bracket (bottom)\n        };\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNullNodeStatuses_IsByteIdenticalToCurrentBehavior()\n    {\n        // The static `graph` command path (no live status) must be UNCHANGED by this feature: the\n        // pre-existing three-argument overload and the new call passing nodeStatuses:null must\n        // produce the exact same document, byte-for-byte — the golden fixtures\n        // (examples/hello-guardrails, docs/plans/08-parallel-execution/diagram.html) are out of this\n        // task's scope and must not need regenerating.\n        string legacy = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget);\n        string newNull = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n\n        Assert.Equal(legacy, newNull);\n\n        // ...and the static path carries NONE of the live-overlay markers. Each of these is absent\n        // from today's template, so their absence pins the null path clean — a leak of the feature\n        // into the static path (which would silently change every checked-in diagram.html) fails here.\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"@keyframes\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", newNull, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAMetaRefreshTag()\n    {\n        // A non-null status map with the default includeRefresh:true is the DURING-RUN diagram — it\n        // must carry <meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"> so a plain file:// view re-reads itself as the run\n        // progresses (mirrors LogSiteRenderer's during-run index). The static (null) path must not.\n        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n        Assert.Contains(\"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        string stat = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, nodeStatuses: null);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", stat, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNodeStatusesAndIncludeRefreshFalse_OmitsTheMetaRefreshTag()\n    {\n        // The FINAL settled render (wired at run-end by 06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand):\n        // nodeStatuses is STILL non-null (every node shows its final settled status) but\n        // includeRefresh:false, so the auto-reload tag is dropped — the page is done refreshing. The\n        // status overlay itself must STILL be emitted (the refresh tag and the overlay are independent).\n        string settled = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(\n            Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses, includeRefresh: false);\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\"http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        // still a live-status document — the overlay data is present regardless of includeRefresh.\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"node-statuses\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"\\\"task_root\\\"\", settled, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithNodeStatuses_EmitsAnOverlayForEachStatusEntry()\n    {\n        // Every node id in the status map must be referenced by the overlay-rendering logic — the\n        // map is embedded as a JSON side-table (mirroring the task-folder-targets side-table) keyed\n        // by the SAME Mermaid node/container ids, so the post-render script can position a badge on\n        // each matching SVG node. Assert the QUOTED (JSON-key) form: a bare-word check would false-\n        // positive on ids like `plan_guardrails` that ALREADY appear in a code comment in today's\n        // template — only the emitted status map produces the quoted form.\n        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n\n        foreach (string nodeId in SampleStatuses.Keys)\n        {\n            Assert.Contains($\"\\\"{nodeId}\\\"\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        }\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_WithRunningStatus_EmitsASpinnerClass_AndSettledStatusesEmitAGlyph()\n    {\n        // \"running\" must render an ANIMATED spinner (a CSS @keyframes rotation — no external\n        // image/GIF dependency), visibly distinct from a settled status's STATIC glyph (check / X /\n        // \"?\"). Assert both the spinner animation + its dedicated class AND at least one settled\n        // glyph are present; the spinner marker (a CSS class) is inherently distinct from the glyph\n        // characters, so a spinner can never be mistaken for a settled state.\n        string live = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, OneTarget, SampleStatuses);\n\n        // spinner: a CSS keyframes rotation + a dedicated class (neither exists in the static template).\n        Assert.Contains(\"@keyframes\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"status-spinner\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        // settled glyphs: `passed` -> U+2713 CHECK MARK, `failed` -> U+2717 BALLOT X (both present in\n        // SampleStatuses). Written as literal UTF-8 glyphs; this file is valid UTF-8, which Roslyn's\n        // BOM-less source detection decodes as UTF-8, so the literals compile to exactly these chars.\n        Assert.Contains(\"✓\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"✗\", live, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    // === diagram search box (issue #220) ================================================\n    //\n    // A fixed-position #search-box overlay (same technique as #legend/#bar/#hint and the status\n    // badges) sits alongside the live status overlay: a search <input>, a \"N of M\" match counter\n    // with next/prev controls, and client-side JS that substring-matches the typed text against\n    // every Mermaid node's id + visible label, toggles a highlight/dim class per node, and auto\n    // pans/zooms to the first match via the already-loaded svg-pan-zoom instance. UNLIKE the status\n    // overlay, this is unconditional — present regardless of nodeStatuses.\n    //\n    // These are structural/string-content assertions (no headless browser is configured in this\n    // repo — a documented Level-A gap): they prove the right markup/data/script is EMITTED, not\n    // that a browser actually matches, highlights, and pans/zooms at runtime. The search-index side\n    // -table is a deliberate stub (BuildSearchIndexJson always returns \"{}\"), so\n    // Render_SearchScript_ReferencesEveryNodeIdAndLabel is the intended TDD RED against it — the\n    // 08-implement-diagram-search-box task turns it green by parsing the real ids/labels.\n\n    // A realistic sample source (mirrors MermaidRenderer's actual shape: a task container plus a\n    // preflight and a guardrail leaf) with ids/labels distinct enough that a false-positive match\n    // against unrelated template text is implausible.\n    private const string SearchSource = \"\"\"\n        flowchart TD\n          subgraph task_root[\"root-task\"]\n            task_root_pf_0[\"pf-check-one\"]:::preflight\n            task_root_gr_0[\"gr-check-one\"]:::guardrail\n          end\n          style task_root fill:#cfe8ff;\n          classDef preflight fill:#e6d7ff;\n          classDef guardrail fill:#fff3cd;\n        \"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_AlwaysEmitsASearchInputElement()\n    {\n        // Unconditional (unlike the status overlay): present whether nodeStatuses is null or not.\n        string withoutStatuses = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n        string withStatuses = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets, SampleStatuses);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"search-input\\\"\", withoutStatuses, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"id=\\\"search-input\\\"\", withStatuses, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_SearchScript_ReferencesEveryNodeIdAndLabel()\n    {\n        // The search-matching data source must actually be POPULATED with the ids and visible\n        // labels a real Mermaid source produces — sliced to the dedicated #search-index side-table\n        // (not a bare page-wide Contains) so this cannot false-positive against the verbatim graph\n        // source, which already contains these same substrings regardless of the search feature.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(SearchSource, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        int indexStart = html.IndexOf(\"id=\\\"search-index\\\"\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(indexStart >= 0, \"the #search-index side-table must be present\");\n        int indexEnd = html.IndexOf(\"</script>\", indexStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        string indexContent = html[indexStart..indexEnd];\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"task_root\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"root-task\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"task_root_pf_0\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"pf-check-one\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"task_root_gr_0\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"gr-check-one\", indexContent, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_SearchScript_DefinesAHighlightAndDimClass()\n    {\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\".search-match\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\".search-dim\", html, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public void Render_SearchScript_CallsThePanZoomApiForAutoCentering()\n    {\n        // Sliced to the runSearch function BODY (not a bare page-wide Contains) so this cannot\n        // false-positive against a comment merely mentioning pz.pan/pz.zoom above the function —\n        // the stub throws before calling either, so this must fail until the real implementation\n        // actually centers the first match through the pan-zoom instance.\n        string html = HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render(Source, Hash, NoTargets);\n\n        int fnStart = html.IndexOf(\"function runSearch(\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(fnStart >= 0, \"runSearch must be defined\");\n        int fnEnd = html.IndexOf(\"\\n}\\n\", fnStart, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.True(fnEnd > fnStart, \"runSearch's closing brace must be found\");\n        string fnBody = html[fnStart..fnEnd];\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"pz.pan(\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"pz.zoom(\", fnBody, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":550,"startLine":1,"totalLines":550}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01PaBMTBu4y1GtRn8qy4Tzfe","type":"tool_result","content":"340\t\n341\t        // --- container→container edges (every container above is already fully declared) -----\n342\t        AppendContainerEdges(graph, tasks, nodeIdBase, sb);\n343\t\n344\t        return nodeIdBase;\n345\t    }\n346\t\n347\t    /// <summary>\n348\t    /// Append a plan-level bracket container (<c>plan_preflights</c> or <c>plan_guardrails</c>):\n349\t    /// its checks (sorted ordinal by name) as small boxes inside, styled with\n350\t    /// <paramref name=\"checkClass\"/>. ALWAYS emitted, even when <paramref name=\"checks\"/> is empty\n351\t    /// — the two plan-level containers are structural brackets on the whole DAG, not conditional\n352\t    /// content. The DAG edge attaches to this container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n353\t    /// </summary>\n354\t    private static void AppendPlanLevelContainer(\n355\t        StringBuilder sb,\n356\t        string containerId,\n357\t        string label,\n358\t        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n359\t        string checkClass)\n360\t    {\n361\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(label)}]\");\n362\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}\", checks, checkClass);\n363\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n364\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {PlanLevelStyle}\");\n365\t    }\n366\t\n367\t    /// <summary>\n368\t    /// Append one task container: its preflight leaf check node(s) (if any), THEN its guardrail\n369\t    /// leaf check node(s) — both DIRECTLY inside the container, with no nested\n370\t    /// <c>Preflights</c>/<c>Guardrails</c> wrapper subgraph (see class remarks, \"Nested boxes\n371\t    /// dropped\") — then the container's <c>style</c> fill. The DAG edge attaches to this\n372\t    /// container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n373\t    /// </summary>\n374\t    /// <remarks>\n375\t    /// <b>Emission-order contract (load-bearing, tested):</b> preflight check nodes are ALWAYS\n376\t    /// emitted before guardrail check nodes within a container. This is not a rendering accident —\n377\t    /// with the nested boxes gone, source order is the only surviving signal that preflights run\n378\t    /// BEFORE the task's attempt loop and guardrails run AFTER it, so callers (and the legend) may\n379\t    /// rely on it as a stable convention.\n380\t    /// </remarks>\n381\t    /// <remarks>\n382\t    /// No anchor node of any kind is emitted here (issue #211's mechanism was removed entirely —\n383\t    /// issue #235; see class remarks). <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> now\n384\t    /// emit byte-identical container/node shape for every task; the container's click target lives\n385\t    /// entirely in <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s post-render JavaScript overlay instead.\n386\t    /// </remarks>\n387\t    private static void AppendTaskContainer(StringBuilder sb, TaskNode task, string @base)\n388\t    {\n389\t        string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n390\t\n391\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(task.Id)}]\");\n392\t\n393\t        // Preflights BEFORE guardrails — see remarks: this order is the emission-order contract\n394\t        // that now carries the \"before the attempt loop\" / \"after the action\" temporal semantic\n395\t        // the removed nested boxes used to convey visually.\n396\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_pf\", task.Preflights, \"preflight\");\n397\t        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_gr\", task.Guardrails, \"guardrail\");\n398\t\n399\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n400\t        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {TaskStyle}\");\n401\t    }\n402\t\n403\t    /// <summary>\n404\t    /// Append <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by name, for input-order independence) as\n405\t    /// <c>{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[label]:::{checkClass}</c> node lines, one per check. Drawn label\n406\t    /// is ALWAYS <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/> — the check's own short, stable identifier\n407\t    /// (the file-derived name, e.g. <c>01-core-tests-green-excluding-target</c>), never the\n408\t    /// (possibly long) <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Description\"/>. A prior version drew the\n409\t    /// description (truncated for task-level preflights only, issue #211) — the owner asked\n410\t    /// instead for the same short, meaningful identifier every box's click target already opens,\n411\t    /// uniformly for every check kind at both scopes (issue #222). The full description remains\n412\t    /// reachable via the node's <c>click</c> tooltip in <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> (issue\n413\t    /// #33's existing click mechanism, unaffected by this change) — no truncation heuristic is\n414\t    /// needed anywhere now.\n415\t    /// </summary>\n416\t    private static void AppendCheckNodes(\n417\t        StringBuilder sb,\n418\t        string indent,\n419\t        string nodeIdPrefix,\n420\t        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n421\t        string checkClass)\n422\t    {\n423\t        int ordinal = 0;\n424\t        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n425\t        {\n426\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"{indent}{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[{Quote(check.Name)}]:::{checkClass}\");\n427\t            ordinal++;\n428\t        }\n429\t    }\n430\t\n431\t    /// <summary>\n432\t    /// Append every container→container edge: the plan-preflights container into each DAG ROOT\n433\t    /// task's container (a task with no <c>dependsOn</c>), one edge per <c>dependsOn</c>\n434\t    /// relationship between two task containers, and each DAG LEAF task's container (a task nothing\n435\t    /// depends on) into the plan-guardrails container. The edge references the container's own\n436\t    /// subgraph id, so Mermaid clips the arrow to the container's OUTER BORDER (issue #210). A\n437\t    /// task-level preflight does not change this — the gated dependency edge is drawn exactly like\n438\t    /// any other; the preflight is only ever a check node inside the consumer's own container\n439\t    /// (emitted before the container's guardrail check nodes — see <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/>).\n440\t    /// </summary>\n441\t    private static void AppendContainerEdges(\n442\t        DependencyGraph graph,\n443\t        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n444\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase,\n445\t        StringBuilder sb)\n446\t    {\n447\t        foreach (TaskNode root in tasks.Where(t => t.DependsOn.Count == 0))\n448\t        {\n449\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"  {PlanPreflightsId} --> task_{nodeIdBase[root.Id]}\");\n450\t        }\n451\t\n452\t        foreach (TaskNode dependency in tasks)\n453\t        {\n454\t            foreach (string dependentId in graph.DependentsOf(dependency.Id)\n455\t                         .OrderBy(id => id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n456\t            {\n457\t                AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[dependency.Id]} --> task_{nodeIdBase[dependentId]}\");\n458\t            }\n459\t        }\n460\t\n461\t        foreach (TaskNode leaf in tasks.Where(t => graph.DependentsOf(t.Id).Count == 0))\n462\t        {\n463\t            AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[leaf.Id]} --> {PlanGuardrailsId}\");\n464\t        }\n465\t    }\n466\t\n467\t    /// <summary>\n468\t    /// Append <c>click</c> directives (HTML-viewer only; see <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>) for\n469\t    /// every CHECK node — plan-level or task-level, preflight or guardrail — opening its own file\n470\t    /// as a plan-relative, forward-slash <c>file://</c> target resolved relative to\n471\t    /// <c>diagram.html</c> at the plan root, opened in a new tab (<c>_blank</c>) so the diagram\n472\t    /// stays put. Emitted in the same ordinal/sorted order as the nodes for determinism, and using\n473\t    /// the SAME node-id scheme as <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> so every click target actually\n474\t    /// exists. A task-level preflight's click tooltip carries its FULL description (not just its\n475\t    /// name) since <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> draws only a truncated label for it — the\n476\t    /// tooltip is the click-for-detail mechanism that keeps the full text from being lost.\n477\t    /// </summary>\n478\t    /// <remarks>\n479\t    /// <b>No container click directive is emitted here (issue #235).</b> A task container's click"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"60fb1c1f-b506-41c2-a945-f51298dbbc45","uuid":"f3e45269-49d4-4cc0-b9f8-2c5d847637ad","timestamp":"2026-07-07T17:12:49.858Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\33574b73\\08-implement-diagram-search-box\\attempt-1\\src\\Guardrails.Core\\Graph\\MermaidRenderer.cs","content":"\n        // --- container→container edges (every container above is already fully declared) -----\n        AppendContainerEdges(graph, tasks, nodeIdBase, sb);\n\n        return nodeIdBase;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append a plan-level bracket container (<c>plan_preflights</c> or <c>plan_guardrails</c>):\n    /// its checks (sorted ordinal by name) as small boxes inside, styled with\n    /// <paramref name=\"checkClass\"/>. ALWAYS emitted, even when <paramref name=\"checks\"/> is empty\n    /// — the two plan-level containers are structural brackets on the whole DAG, not conditional\n    /// content. The DAG edge attaches to this container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendPlanLevelContainer(\n        StringBuilder sb,\n        string containerId,\n        string label,\n        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n        string checkClass)\n    {\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(label)}]\");\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}\", checks, checkClass);\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {PlanLevelStyle}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append one task container: its preflight leaf check node(s) (if any), THEN its guardrail\n    /// leaf check node(s) — both DIRECTLY inside the container, with no nested\n    /// <c>Preflights</c>/<c>Guardrails</c> wrapper subgraph (see class remarks, \"Nested boxes\n    /// dropped\") — then the container's <c>style</c> fill. The DAG edge attaches to this\n    /// container's own subgraph id (no interior anchor).\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// <b>Emission-order contract (load-bearing, tested):</b> preflight check nodes are ALWAYS\n    /// emitted before guardrail check nodes within a container. This is not a rendering accident —\n    /// with the nested boxes gone, source order is the only surviving signal that preflights run\n    /// BEFORE the task's attempt loop and guardrails run AFTER it, so callers (and the legend) may\n    /// rely on it as a stable convention.\n    /// </remarks>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// No anchor node of any kind is emitted here (issue #211's mechanism was removed entirely —\n    /// issue #235; see class remarks). <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> now\n    /// emit byte-identical container/node shape for every task; the container's click target lives\n    /// entirely in <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/>'s post-render JavaScript overlay instead.\n    /// </remarks>\n    private static void AppendTaskContainer(StringBuilder sb, TaskNode task, string @base)\n    {\n        string containerId = $\"task_{@base}\";\n\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  subgraph {containerId}[{Quote(task.Id)}]\");\n\n        // Preflights BEFORE guardrails — see remarks: this order is the emission-order contract\n        // that now carries the \"before the attempt loop\" / \"after the action\" temporal semantic\n        // the removed nested boxes used to convey visually.\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_pf\", task.Preflights, \"preflight\");\n        AppendCheckNodes(sb, \"    \", $\"{containerId}_gr\", task.Guardrails, \"guardrail\");\n\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  end\");\n        AppendLf(sb, $\"  style {containerId} {TaskStyle}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append <paramref name=\"checks\"/> (sorted ordinal by name, for input-order independence) as\n    /// <c>{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[label]:::{checkClass}</c> node lines, one per check. Drawn label\n    /// is ALWAYS <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/> — the check's own short, stable identifier\n    /// (the file-derived name, e.g. <c>01-core-tests-green-excluding-target</c>), never the\n    /// (possibly long) <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Description\"/>. A prior version drew the\n    /// description (truncated for task-level preflights only, issue #211) — the owner asked\n    /// instead for the same short, meaningful identifier every box's click target already opens,\n    /// uniformly for every check kind at both scopes (issue #222). The full description remains\n    /// reachable via the node's <c>click</c> tooltip in <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> (issue\n    /// #33's existing click mechanism, unaffected by this change) — no truncation heuristic is\n    /// needed anywhere now.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendCheckNodes(\n        StringBuilder sb,\n        string indent,\n        string nodeIdPrefix,\n        IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks,\n        string checkClass)\n    {\n        int ordinal = 0;\n        foreach (GuardrailDefinition check in checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"{indent}{nodeIdPrefix}_{ordinal}[{Quote(check.Name)}]:::{checkClass}\");\n            ordinal++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append every container→container edge: the plan-preflights container into each DAG ROOT\n    /// task's container (a task with no <c>dependsOn</c>), one edge per <c>dependsOn</c>\n    /// relationship between two task containers, and each DAG LEAF task's container (a task nothing\n    /// depends on) into the plan-guardrails container. The edge references the container's own\n    /// subgraph id, so Mermaid clips the arrow to the container's OUTER BORDER (issue #210). A\n    /// task-level preflight does not change this — the gated dependency edge is drawn exactly like\n    /// any other; the preflight is only ever a check node inside the consumer's own container\n    /// (emitted before the container's guardrail check nodes — see <see cref=\"AppendTaskContainer\"/>).\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendContainerEdges(\n        DependencyGraph graph,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase,\n        StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        foreach (TaskNode root in tasks.Where(t => t.DependsOn.Count == 0))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"  {PlanPreflightsId} --> task_{nodeIdBase[root.Id]}\");\n        }\n\n        foreach (TaskNode dependency in tasks)\n        {\n            foreach (string dependentId in graph.DependentsOf(dependency.Id)\n                         .OrderBy(id => id, StringComparer.Ordinal))\n            {\n                AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[dependency.Id]} --> task_{nodeIdBase[dependentId]}\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (TaskNode leaf in tasks.Where(t => graph.DependentsOf(t.Id).Count == 0))\n        {\n            AppendLf(sb, $\"  task_{nodeIdBase[leaf.Id]} --> {PlanGuardrailsId}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append <c>click</c> directives (HTML-viewer only; see <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>) for\n    /// every CHECK node — plan-level or task-level, preflight or guardrail — opening its own file\n    /// as a plan-relative, forward-slash <c>file://</c> target resolved relative to\n    /// <c>diagram.html</c> at the plan root, opened in a new tab (<c>_blank</c>) so the diagram\n    /// stays put. Emitted in the same ordinal/sorted order as the nodes for determinism, and using\n    /// the SAME node-id scheme as <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> so every click target actually\n    /// exists. A task-level preflight's click tooltip carries its FULL description (not just its\n    /// name) since <see cref=\"AppendCheckNodes\"/> draws only a truncated label for it — the\n    /// tooltip is the click-for-detail mechanism that keeps the full text from being lost.\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// <b>No container click directive is emitted here (issue #235).</b> A task container's click","numLines":140,"startLine":340,"totalLines":648}}}
